risks.title: Deterioration of general economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is ranked first among risk factors with strong language (materially adversely affect). It covers several interconnected threats such as recession, inflation, and unemployment. Repeatedly presented in the text with increased intensity. High weighting for macroeconomic risks in the consumer sector.

risks.title: Commodity input cost inflation and supply chain volatility
risks.score_rationale: Repeatedly mentioned with alarming language (materially and adversely affected). The text emphasizes the potential inability to fully offset these increases. Risk exacerbated by trade tensions and tariffs. Industrially weighted category.

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions and operational inefficiencies
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly linked to recent and recurring events. Mentions sourcing, transportation, and labor challenges. Assertive language but less alarming than inflation. Stable trend, integrated into ongoing operations.

risks.title: Geopolitical conflicts and global trade policy volatility
risks.score_rationale: The risk is detailed with concrete examples (Ukraine, Middle East, China-Taiwan). Mentions direct impacts on costs and supply chain. Language strengthened compared to prior year, with explicit linkage to other risks. Geopolitical category increasing in importance.

risks.title: Product recalls and food safety litigation
risks.score_rationale: Existential risk for a food company. Mentions strict liability, voluntary recalls, and potential criminal penalties. Very strong language and central positioning within operational risks. Direct impact on reputation.

risks.title: Commodity derivatives volatility and hedging effectiveness
risks.score_rationale: Direct impact on gross margin and net earnings through derivative accounting. While partially managed, the text acknowledges inevitable volatility. Less critical than inflation itself, but a financial risk amplifier.

risks.title: Regulatory changes in food labeling and advertising
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions increased scrutiny, growing litigation, and new requirements (allergens, nutrients, packaging). Risk of additional costs and penalties. Precise language and context of rising regulatory pressure.

ai_positioning.summary: Conagra Brands does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The information provided focuses on financial aspects, business segments, and restructuring plans.
